title: qTonttuzz Pack
description: This Resource Pack Is Made For PvP And Survival!
body:
Hello, i made this resource pack for PvP, but it can be used for other things too! For example survival and building because it doesn't change the block textures!


## Features
- Retexturd Bow
- Clear Water
- Clean rain/snow weather
- Clean crystals
- No pumpkin blur 
- No vignette
- No explosive particles
- Low shield
- Low fire
- Red/Blood critical hit
- Low shield
- Red tripwire
- Small totem and pop
- Crossbow pulling colors
- Old enchant glint
- Outlined ores
